body.title: docs: fix file paths in static assets example
body.body:
Resolves #1578

The "Read files" example mounts the handler at `/public/**`, but `serveStatic` passes the full request path as `id` (e.g. `/public/index.html`). So `join("public", id)` looks for `public/public/index.html` and every request returns 404. The text also says to open `http://localhost:3000`, which isn't matched by `/public/**`.

Changes:
- Strip the `/public` prefix from `id` before joining it with the directory.
- Point readers to `http://localhost:3000/public/`, after the full example.

I checked both versions against h3 2.0.2 with a `public/index.html` file:

| Path | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | 404 | 404 (outside the mount, expected) |
| `/public/` | 404 | 200 |
| `/public/index.html` | 404 | 200 |

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Documentation**
  * Updated the static assets example to show creating `public/index.html` before opening `/public/` in a browser.
  * Clarified that `/public` is removed from request paths before they’re used to read files or look up file metadata.

body.title: fix(mime): serve .wasm as application/wasm
body.body:
`.wasm` isn't in `COMMON_MIME_TYPES`, so `serveStatic` sends it as `text/plain; charset=UTF-8` on node and with no content-type on web. `WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming()` requires `application/wasm` and rejects the response otherwise.

`instantiateStreaming(await app.request("/module.wasm"))` on node 22:

```
main: TypeError: WebAssembly response has unsupported MIME type 'null'
this: ok
```

added it to the table, with a test that fails on main for web and node.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * `.wasm` files are now served with the `application/wasm` content type.
